card.name: Just before liver test names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation right before ALT, AST or liver function tests, such as "increased", "in", "including", a comma, a bullet or an open bracket. The next word is expected to be a liver enzyme or hepatic panel.

modes.label: Grade wording before ALT/AST
modes.description: "increased" or "in" after a grade, right before ALT or AST.
modes.example: Among the 44 patients with Grade ≥2<< increased>> ALT or AST who were rechalleng

modes.label: Lists of lab monitoring
modes.description: A bullet, comma, "including" or "and" in a list of lab tests, just before liver tests.
modes.example: and chemistries (<<including>> liver function tests and uric acid)

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward predicting liver enzyme and hepatic test names next.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a liver test such as ALT, AST or a hepatic panel is named.
